items.title: Barry Harris — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ve even had Clint Eastwood at one of my big concerts. Clint Eastwood had us all, that’s another story, Clint Eastwood had us all, a lot of jazz musicians, come to California while he was making this movie about Bird.

ctx.x: You can imagine that. So I have a good relationship with Berry Gordy, you know, he’s come to see me play concerts in California, you know. We had him to dinner at a Japanese restaurant when he came to town, he came to my big concert, he came to one of my big concerts. I’ve even had Clint Eastwood at one of my big concerts.
